versions.changelog:
v4.5.2 — June 2026

Multi-LLM routing: Elite modes now use Claude Sonnet 4.6 for superior analysis quality; standard modes use Claude Haiku for speed
Sources, confidence, and market_score promoted to root level of response for programmatic trust validation (M2M)
M2M Trust Protocol added to mcp.json, agent-card, discovery resources, and llms-full.txt — includes agent decision pipeline and machine_trust_protocol
Trial key endpoint: GET /api-keys/trial — 5 free calls, no wallet required
Security: removed test_valid payment bypass — all calls now require verified on-chain payment or valid key
Batch endpoint now accepts X-SESSION and X-API-KEY in addition to x402
Path-aware 422 handlers with exact schema examples per endpoint
Budget guidance field added to market_entry_execution mode
JSON truncation recovery — no more parse_error on large outputs
Data privacy warning added to skill description and documentation

10 context modes including venture_screening, regulatory_compliance, 
sales_enablement, and crypto_protocol. Battlecard output in 
sales_enablement mode. Verified web sources via Exa in every analysis. 
HTML report format for humans (format=report). force_refresh parameter. 
Updated domain to api.intelica.dev. market_signals field with funding, 
headcount, and pricing data.

- Added detailed documentation on context modes for multiple analysis scenarios (competitive, fundraising, partnership, acquisition, market entry).
- Improved guidance on pay-per-call via x402 protocol on Base and Solana mainnets; no API keys required.
- Introduced usage examples for free demo, single, and batch analysis endpoints.
- Expanded output documentation, detailing JSON structure and trend tracking fields.
- Clarified language auto-detection and regional context injection (supports 8 languages).
- Added recommendations for spend-aware and budget-limited usage.
